|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). The sheet copy that survives is the February 2003 re-issue PDF; the date of the first release is unknown (the sheet gives the legal date 20 September 2002). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' (this page): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #3 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 20 September 2002; first release date unknown). Full text: “Deploy on table. Once during the power segment of a battle, may use X Force to reduce a starship's immunity to attrition by X. Once per turn, may use 2 Force to cancel the game text of a senator (or a character with a maintenance cost) for the remainder of the turn.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Astromech Shortage (V) (Virtual Set 3) (Errata)]]): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 3: Revolution, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “Deploy on table. During the power segment of a battle, may use X Force to reduce a starship’s immunity to attrition by X for remainder of turn. Once per turn, may use 2 Force to cancel the game text of a [Maintenance] character or a senator for remainder of turn.” '''What changed:''' “Once during” → “During”; “starship's” → “starship’s”; “X.” → “X for remainder of turn.”; added “[Maintenance] character or a”; removed “(or a character with a maintenance cost)”; removed “the”; removed “the”.
|sources=* [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards3.pdf#page=3 VirtualCards3.pdf] — the Players Committee's Virtual Set #3 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 20 September 2002; first release date unknown); page 3, slip 29. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[Astromech Shortage]].
* Later text: [[Astromech Shortage (V) (Virtual Set 3) (Errata)]] (the 4 December 2006 remaster).
|hatnote=Other versions of this Virtual Original card: [[Astromech Shortage (V) (Virtual Set 3) (Errata)]]. For the Decipher card this slip modifies, see [[Astromech Shortage]].
